name: zimage_tex_index_to_dir_entry
description: zImage::TexIndexToDirEntry maps serialized texture directory index -1 to null and all other indexes to the corresponding global texture-directory entry.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zImage texture-directory/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46d340 validates the fastcall index input, -1-to-null special case, and 36-byte stride calculation from g_zImage_TexDirEntries.
The native texture-directory write smoke verifies -1 returns null and a live index returns the matching g_zImage_TexDirEntries slot.
